rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before real data; synthetic validation at N 4-32 (Amendment 1, scope only, before real data); replication on 34 periods in content (both models), talk and activity; two natives (G51, G38); style-resid variant and training-window variant; scorecard; frozen, guarded confirm script dry-run, not run.
rationale.faithfulness: Clipping beats raw out of sample in 26-27/32 periods with a CI above zero, and the gain follows the random-matrix signature (grows with N/T, falls with training length; unfitted). The HH's stronger claim fails: clipping ties Ledoit-Wolf constant-correlation shrinkage (17/32 vs the best shrinkage). Talk room structure is erased by cleaning. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D2 E0 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: A computable monitor rule from standard logs: forecast tomorrow's pair co-movement from a cleaned or shrunk matrix, not raw (about 10% lower error; 30% skill over a no-correlation forecast in content, ~0 in talk). It also tells an operator that pair-level content structure beyond one uniform mode is not persistent day to day. No lever.

one_line: RMT clipping forecasts tomorrow's agent content correlations 10% better than raw (26-27/32 periods; gain grows with N/T) but only ties constant-correlation shrinkage; talk pairs are not forecastable.

raters.claim: For next-day agent content correlation forecasts inside a unit, clipping eigenvalues at a calibrated noise edge beats the raw sample matrix (mean MSE gain 0.10, 26/32 and 27/32 periods, both models) but only ties Ledoit-Wolf constant-correlation shrinkage (within ~2%): the persistent structure is one uniform mode. Excluded: talk/activity channels, MP-edge comparison (P5 failed), G38 room block.
ladder: rival beaten on held-out data (raw matrix beaten out-of-sample on the next day)
robust (both embedding models; style-resid variant keeps P1 at 0.78/0.88)
tie clause is sample-sensitive (mean gain vs LW-CC -0.020/-0.008 while clip wins 20-21/32 periods); calibrated edge keeps spurious modes in up to 17% of noise fits
